blocks.text: Jab tennis ki do gendein takrati hain to takrao ke baad woh takrao se pehle se kam velocities se wapas uchhalti hain: kinetic energy ka ek hissa zaya hota hai, kuch raghrat se jab gendon ke bigarne par gend ke molecules ek doosre ke paas se guzarte hain, aur kuch garmi aur awaz ki energy mein badalne se.

blocks.title: Inelastic aur perfectly elastic takrao
blocks.text: Aisa takrao jis mein system ki kinetic energy baqi na rahe inelastic collision kehlata hai. Kuch khaas halaat mein koi kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti; mithali soorat mein jab koi kinetic energy zaya na ho, takrao perfectly elastic kehlata hai. Maslan sang-e-marmar ke farsh par girai sakht gend taqreeban apni ibtidai oonchai tak wapas uchhalti hai, farsh se takrao mein na-qabil-e-zikr energy khoti hai. Momentum aur kul energy har qism ke takrao mein baqi rehte hain; kinetic energy sirf elastic takrao mein baqi rehti hai.

Masses m1 aur m2 ki do chikni, na-ghoomti gendein lein jo shuru mein velocities v1 aur v2 se ek hi simt mein chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain aur baad mein baghair ghoome usi seedhi lakeer mein velocities v1' aur v2' se chalti hain (Fig. 2.10). Velocity aur momentum ki musbat simt daen taraf le kar, momentum ke baqa ke qanoon se m1 v1 + m2 v2 = m1 v1' + m2 v2', ya m1 (v1 - v1') = m2 (v2' - v2) ... (2.29). Chunke takrao elastic hai, kinetic energy baqi rehti hai: (1/2) m1 v1^2 + (1/2) m2 v2^2 = (1/2) m1 v1'^2 + (1/2) m2 v2'^2, ya m1 (v1^2 - v1'^2) = m2 (v2'^2 - v2^2), ya m1 (v1 + v1')(v1 - v1') = m2 (v2' + v2)(v2' - v2) ... (2.30). Eq. (2.30) ko (2.29) par taqseem karne se v1 + v1' = v2' + v2 ... (2.31), ya v1 - v2 = v2' - v1' = -(v1' - v2'). Takrao se pehle v1 - v2 doosri gend ki nisbat pehli gend ki velocity hai, aur v1' - v2' baad ki nisbati velocity; to takrao se pehle aur baad ki nisbati velocities ki miqdar ek jaisi magar simt ulti hai: qareeb aane ki nisbati velocity ki miqdar alag hone ki nisbati velocity ki miqdar ke barabar hai.

(2.29) aur (2.30) mein m1, m2, v1 aur v2 maloom hain; na-maloom v1' aur v2' ke liye hal karne se v1' = ((m1 - m2)/(m1 + m2)) v1 + (2 m2/(m1 + m2)) v2 ... (2.32) aur v2' = (2 m1/(m1 + m2)) v1 + ((m2 - m1)/(m1 + m2)) v2 ... (2.33) milte hain.

items: Jab m1 = m2: (2.32) aur (2.33) se v1' = v2 aur v2' = v1 (Fig. 2.11): gendein velocities badal leti hain.

Jab m1 = m2 aur v2 = 0: m2 sukoon mein ho to (2.32) aur (2.33) se v1' = 0 aur v2' = v1: gend m1 ruk jati hai aur m2 us velocity se chal parti hai jo m1 ki thi (Fig. 2.12), jaise mez par chalti billiard gend bilkul waisi hi sukoon mein gend se takraye.

Jab halka jism sukoon mein bhari jism se takraye: v2 = 0 aur m2, m1 se bohat bara, to m2 ke muqable m1 nazar andaz ho sakta hai, aur (2.32) aur (2.33) se v1' = -v1 aur v2' = 0 (Fig. 2.13): m1 usi velocity se wapas uchhalta hai jabke m2 sukoon mein rehta hai, jo squash player istemal karta hai.

Jab bhari jism halke sukoon mein jism se takraye: m1, m2 se bohat bara aur v2 = 0, to (2.32) aur (2.33) mein m2 nazar andaz, jis se v1' taqreeban v1 aur v2' taqreeban 2 v1 (Fig. 2.14): bhari jism ki velocity mein amalan koi tabdeeli nahi, magar halka aage ki simt mein aane wale jism ki taqreeban dugni velocity se uchhalta hai.

blocks.caption: Momentum, impulse, takrao aur rocket propulsion (Figures 2.9 se 2.18 aur topics 2.7 se 2.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Momentum mass zarb velocity hai, aur jism par force us ke momentum ke badalne ki raftar ke barabar hai, to force ka impulse, us ka lagne ke waqt se hasil-e-zarb, momentum ki tabdeeli ke barabar hai. Isolated system mein do takrate ajsam ke darmiyan barabar aur ulti forces un ke momenta ko barabar aur ulti miqdar se badalti hain, to kul momentum nahi badalta. Seedhe elastic takrao mein kinetic energy bhi baqi rehti hai, alag hone ki nisbati velocity qareeb aane ki nisbati velocity ke barabar hai, barabar masses velocities badal lete hain, halki gend sukoon mein bhari se wapas uchhalti hai, aur bhari gend halki ko apni taqreeban dugni speed se chala deti hai. Terhe elastic takrao mein momentum aane ki lakeer ke saath aur us ke aar paar baqi rehta hai jabke kinetic energy scalar ke taur par baqi rehti hai. Perfectly inelastic takrao mein ajsam chipak jate hain, mushtarka velocity momentum se milti hai, aur kinetic energy ka utna hissa zaya hota hai jitna kul mass mein target ka hissa hai. Rocket apne phenki gas ke barabar aur ulta momentum pata hai, to us ka acceleration har second phenka mass zarb gas ki velocity taqseem rocket ka mass hai, jo eendhan istemal hone par barhta hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.8
blocks.text: 70 g ki gend 140 g ki doosri gend se takrati hai. Pehli gend ki ibtidai velocity 9 m s^-1 daen taraf hai jabke doosri sukoon mein hai. Agar takrao perfectly elastic ho to takrao ke baad dono gendon ki velocities kya hongi? Hal: m1 = 70 g, v1 = 9 m s^-1, v2 = 0, m2 = 140 g. v1' = ((m1 - m2)/(m1 + m2)) v1 = ((70 g - 140 g)/(70 g + 140 g)) x 9 m s^-1 = -3 m s^-1; v2' = (2 m1/(m1 + m2)) v1 = (2 x 70 g/(70 g + 140 g)) x 9 m s^-1 = 6 m s^-1.

blocks.prompt: Elastic aur inelastic takrao mein farq karein, aur wazeh karein ke squash ki gend deewar se taqreeban apni aane wali speed se kyun wapas uchhalti hai (short question 2.3; soorat iii).
blocks.explanation: Elastic takrao mein momentum aur kinetic energy dono baqi rehte hain; inelastic mein momentum baqi rehta hai magar kuch kinetic energy garmi, awaz ya bigaar ban jati hai. Kul energy aur momentum dono mein baqi rehte hain. Gend halki aur deewar bhari aur sukoon mein hai, to m2 ke muqable m1 na-qabil-e-zikr maan kar formulas v1' = -v1 aur v2' = 0 dete hain: gend usi speed se wapas uchhalti hai aur deewar apni jagah rehti hai.

items: Inelastic: kinetic energy baqi nahi; perfectly elastic: koi kinetic energy zaya nahi. Momentum aur kul energy har takrao mein baqi.

Seedha elastic: m1 (v1 - v1') = m2 (v2' - v2); v1 + v1' = v2 + v2' (qareeb aane ki speed = alag hone ki speed); v1' = ((m1 - m2)/(m1 + m2)) v1 + (2 m2/(m1 + m2)) v2, v2' = (2 m1/(m1 + m2)) v1 + ((m2 - m1)/(m1 + m2)) v2; chaar khaas soortein. Example 2.8: -3 aur 6 m s^-1.
